flowRoot.flowPara: RAID BOSS TIPS
• The dark red spaces on the map grid is the preferred start space for Golgothon. If those spaces are blocked by walls or pillars, he can be shifted into an open area within the lighter red squares.

• Golgothon is a huge creature made largely of earth and stone. If players wonder why he can push them around when he moves and why their debuffs and forced movement effects aren't as effective, that's why!
• Keep in mind that forced movements always force a unit at least 1 square, even if that unit has Sturdy.
Encounter Setup
• Shuffle 25 map tiles and lay them out in 5 rows of 5 tiles each, forming a 5x5 tile battlefield (10x10 total squares).
• Determine which side of the battlefield is north.
• The starting locations for Golgothon and the player units are marked on the grid to the right:
= default start for Golgothon
= flex space for Golgothon
= available starts for players
Statistics and Traits
• Health: 450
(This value is tuned for a 4-player group. For information on scaling the encounter for more or less players, see p.8)
• Resolve 2 (Debuffs do not apply to this unit until it has 2 debuffs of the same type. It clears 2 debuffs at a time.)
• Large (This unit takes up a 2x2 space on the map.)
• Trample (This unit can enter squares occupied by other units. If it does, those units are forced into the nearest open square.)
• Sturdy 1 (Any forced movement against this unit is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.)

flowRoot.flowPara: Read the following when this skill is first used.
The ground beneath your feet seems to come alive, as a trio of expressionless undead rise from the ground and wrap their decaying arms around you.
Welcoming
Dead
The foe furthest from Golgothon.
Golgothon summons 3 Welcoming Dead minions in the nearest unoccupied squares to target foe.
NOTE: If Carrion Spew replaces Grave Smash in this step, Golgothon still uses Carrion Spew in Step V (thus he will do two Carrion Spews that turn).
NOTE: If the force would move the unit into a wall or other unit, nothing happens.
>> Damage dealt to Golgothon's minions isn't factored in when determing who it targets.
>> Golgothon always moves toward his target, even he has no chance of reaching them. Remember that he forces other units out of his way while moving.
>> Minions prefer to spawn in squares further from Golgothon.
>> Minions may spawn on the other side of a wall from the targeted player.
Read the following when this skill is first used.

flowRoot.flowPara: Golgothon strikes out with a massive stone fist. The impact leaves you dazed.
Move 4 squares toward target. Then, if in melee range, strike target for 10(±2) damage and inflict Daze 1. Otherwise, use Carrion Spew on that foe.
The foe that dealt the most total damage to Golgothon this turn.
Grave Smash
The foe with the highest health in range.
Strike the target for 6(±2) damage and
force it 1 square in a random direction.
Carrion Spew
